#!/bin/sh
set -e
echo "=== Installing dependencies ==="
apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y git curl build-essential

echo "=== Installing Rust toolchain ==="
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain nightly
fi

# Source the cargo environment from wherever rustup created it
if [ -f "/usr/local/cargo/env" ]; then
  . "/usr/local/cargo/env"
elif [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/env" ]; then
  . "$HOME/.cargo/env"
fi

echo "=== Installing Astral UV ==="
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
fi
export PATH="/usr/local/cargo/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"

#echo "=== Fetching Exo repository ==="
#if [ ! -d "/home/exo/.git" ]; then
#  git clone https://github.com/exo-explore/exo /home/exo
#else
#  cd /home/exo && git pull
#fi

echo "=== Fetching Exo repository (brydenver2/exo:copilot/merge-gpu-support-features) ==="
if [ ! -d "/home/exo/.git" ]; then
  git clone -b copilot/merge-gpu-support-features https://github.com/brydenver2/exo /home/exo
else
  cd /home/exo
  git fetch origin
  git checkout copilot/merge-gpu-support-features
  git pull origin copilot/merge-gpu-support-features
fi

echo "=== Syncing Python dependencies ==="
cd /home/exo
uv sync

echo "=== Building Exo Dashboard UI ==="
cd /home/exo/dashboard
npm install
npm run build

echo "=== Installation complete ==="

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

source /opt/gow/bash-lib/utils.sh

# Force root: 10-setup_user.sh becomes a no-op and we never gosu.
export UNAME=root PUID=0 PGID=0 HOME=/root

for init_script in /etc/cont-init.d/*.sh; do
  gow_log
  gow_log "[ $${init_script}: executing... ]"
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  source "$${init_script}"
done

gow_log "Launching the container's startup script as root"
chmod +x /opt/gow/startup.sh
exec /opt/gow/startup.sh

log:
  level: info

runner:
  file: .runner
  capacity: 1
  envs:
    CLEEB: true
    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2376
    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: 1
    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: /certs/client
  env_file: .env
  timeout: 3h
  insecure: false
  fetch_timeout: 5s
  fetch_interval: 2s
  labels: []

cache:
  enabled: true
  dir: "/cache"
  host: ""
  port: 0

container:
  network: "host"
  enable_ipv6: false
  privileged: false
  options: -v /certs/client:/certs/client
  workdir_parent: /workspace
    - /certs/client
  docker_host: ""

host:
  # The parent directory of a job's working directory.
  # If it's empty, $HOME/.cache/act/ will be used.
  workdir_parent:

if [ -f /data/.runner ]; then
  echo "Runner already registered, skipping"
  exit 0
fi
echo "Registering runner...";
forgejo-runner register \
  --labels "ubuntu-latest:docker://ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-latest" \
  --no-interactive \
  --instance https://git.cnas.dev \
  --token "$(RUNNER_TOKEN)" \
  --name k8s-runner-rooted
while ! nc -z localhost 2376 </dev/null; do echo 'waiting for docker daemon...'; sleep 5; done; forgejo-runner --config /config/config.yaml daemon
